description: Get your souvenir postcard: a text, your badges, the rooms you visited and your favorite piece, plus the URL of the postcard image (SVG) and a frozen copy of it (imagen_fija_url) with its own permanent address, kept 12 months, to hand to whoever sent you.

visitor_name.description: Your name as a visitor (max 40 chars). The same name always gives the same avatar, stamps and badges. Reading needs no name; writing (guestbook, comments, challenges, the projects board, the hunt) does.
